title: Flint Spear
description: Adds a simple flint spear to the game, similar to the stone spear.
body: # Description Adds a simple flint spear to the game. Looks like a netherite spear (with slightly different texture) but has the same stats (2 attack damage) as a stone spear. The purpose is to add a realistic recipe, and it may not improve the quality of gamepelay too much but it makes sense as a feature. Make sure the required resource pack is installed if using datapack version. # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21.11 - 26.2 # Compatibility Incompatible with anything with the same filenames or recipe. Should work fine with anything that doesn't replace it with another flint spear.
